acceptanceCriteria: A repeated call returns the same path and branch without creating a second worktree.
The branch name derives only from the ticket id and the declared pattern.
A dirty existing worktree is reported, never reset.
The result includes the repository identity and head revision.
Paths outside the declared repository root are refused.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1031 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Agents that work on a second repository (for example a docs repository) repeatedly stop because no authorized worktree exists for their ticket. The queue binds attempts to its own repository but does not create or reuse a per-ticket worktree elsewhere. Current workaround A script creates or reuses a worktree for the ticket on a ticket-named branch from a base head and prints the path. Proposal A program-level declaration `worktrees: {repository, base, branchPattern}` and `corvint-tasks worktree ensure <ticket>`, which creates or reuses the worktree idempotently, refuses when the base is not a clean ancestor, and records the worktree head when the attempt is released or completed. See beamfall/corvint#1031 for the full text.
title: tasks: ensure a per-ticket worktree on a ticket-named branch in a declared repository (issue #1031)
